effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in their texts delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon in battle, delete 1 of their suspended Digimon or Tamers.
